label: lem:cyclotomic-algebraic
title: Cyclotomic field is algebraic over $\mathbb{Q}$
statement: For every $n : \mathbb{N}$, the Mathlib field \verb|CyclotomicField n ℚ| is algebraic over $\mathbb{Q}$.
proof:
Split on whether $n = 0$.

  \emph{Case $n = 0$.}  By \verb|Polynomial.cyclotomic_zero|, the zeroth cyclotomic polynomial is the constant $1$ (not $X - 1$).  Consequently \verb|CyclotomicField 0 ℚ|, being the splitting field of $1$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, is canonically $\mathbb{Q}$-isomorphic to $\mathbb{Q}$ itself.  Thus it is trivially algebraic over $\mathbb{Q}$ (every element of $\mathbb{Q}$ satisfies $X - q = 0$).

  \emph{Case $n \geq 1$.}  Here we have the instance \verb|NeZero n| (from $n \neq 0$, recorded via \verb|haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩|), which is required by \verb|IsCyclotomicExtension.numberField|.  Specialising that instance to $\{n\} \subseteq \mathbb{N}_{>0}$ with base $K = \mathbb{Q}$ (a number field via \verb|Rat.numberField|) shows that \verb|CyclotomicField n ℚ| is a number field; equivalently, \verb|CyclotomicField.instNumberField| supplies the same conclusion.  Now \verb|NumberField.isAlgebraic| gives \verb|Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ (CyclotomicField n ℚ)|.
